description: DEP Green Infrastructure (Porous Pavement Right of Way Practices) is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. This dataset contains the locations and detailed information of green infrastructure practices in NYC neighborhoods built primarily through NYC Green Infrastructure Program initiatives. Green infrastructure (GI) collects stormwater from streets, sidewalks, and other hard surfaces before it can enter the sewer system or cause local flooding. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Environment. Its tags are green infrastructure. The table has 31 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Environmental Protection (DEP). The portal shows 2026-08-06 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
